{{Libra}}
Libra 1 is the 281st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 1st day of Libra, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 41, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮1日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 281|Chapter 281]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152300}}.
